title: The 100-Day Kingship Plan Begins
overview: Xiaoming comes up with the brilliant idea of creating a special menu in honor of King Lie.

title: Illiteracy Ruins the Magic Lesson
overview: After merging, Xiaoming and Lie must find a way to achieve their respective goals.

title: The Ultimate Grimoire Appears
overview: On a mission to find a spellbook, Xiaoming tries out to become a cook.

title: A Recipe Too Awful to Watch
overview: Head Chef Ramsay wants to uncover the secret behind Xiaoming's recipe and sets a trap for him.

title: Not a Duel, Just a Stiff Neck
overview: Xiaoming must prove he memorized the entire spellbook, but his stiff neck won't make it easy.

title: King Lie's Cover Blown Too Soon!
overview: To conquer the kingdom, Xiaoming and company must win the hearts of the people.

title: Reborn as the Ultimate Wealthy Tycoon
overview: Liang will stop at nothing to put Xiaoming out of business and save his own.

title: Girls Really Are Brave and Adorable!
overview: A dangerous prisoner has escaped from the dungeons, and it seems he has a very clear mission.

title: If You Like Someone, Be Bold and Confess!
overview: They discover Xiaoming's power to create bread. Lei Wan gets him drunk, causing destructive, magical burps.

title: Touch My People and Die!
overview: Because he helped Xiaoming, Ba comes into conflict with the Captain of the Guard.

title: Look Up! There's Gold in the Sky!
overview: Xiaoming infiltrates the guard post using the captain's corpse and discovers a massive treasure.

title: Snatching the Title of District Chief!
overview: Xiaoming wants to buy the District 10 Chief position and discovers just how corrupt the bureaucracy is.

title: Reviving District 10
overview: Xiaoming and Lie seek a way for a district as poor and corrupt as District 10 to prosper.

title: Magic for the Masses
overview: Xiaoming finds a spell for transferring magic, but doesn't know how to perform it.

title: The Hero Saves the Beauty?! What a Cliché Plot!
overview: The new mages are beginning their training.

title: Then How About a Taste of My Fist?!
overview: Xiaoming face an enemy immune to magic and physical blows.

title: Every Show of Support is a Battle!
overview: Xiaoming tries to revive Liang, and Lei Wan faces an unexpected attack.

title: The Miraculous Cure
overview: Huang attempts to save Liang, and Xiaoming will have to deal with the death of the District 9 Chief.

title: Who Am I?! I'm Your Big Bro!
overview: Qin Tian wants to see the Chief of District 9, and Xiaoming will have to find a way to deceive him.
